decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display sits close to the core and costs little to keep, but it was not visible on the website in 2020–2021, which suggests waning prominence and a raised risk of withdrawal now that four years of results have largely resolved its value.

The pegboard-back display still uses existing cardboard capabilities at low holding cost, but its absence from the website after 2019 signals limited demand, so the option is weaker and close to the abandonment threshold.

The standard quarter-pallet display is a core format with steady demand and negligible holding cost, so the missing website listing more likely reflects a site change than a resolved negative outcome.
The eighth-pallet display rounds out the format range at minimal marginal cost, so it stays open despite its lower visibility after 2019.

The wooden pallet lies outside the paper core and costs more to sustain, and its disappearance from the website after four years indicates the diversification option has not proved its value, so the resources are better redeployed.
